english.title: Exporter fail to deliver required particulars / documents not contained in / delivered with entry
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an exporter when an entry which did not comply with section 53 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 had been accepted, failed to deliver to the proper officer within the allowed time

(A)_[such of the particulars as were required to be, but were not contained in or delivered with the entry]_
(B)_[such of the documents as were required to be but were not contained in or delivered with the entry]_
(C)_[a substituted entry permitted by the proper officer and complying with that section]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 54(3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Allforiwr yn methu darparu manylion / dogfennau gofynnol nad oeddynt wedi'u cynnwys yn / darparu gyda'r cofnod
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n allforiwr pan dderbyniwyd cofnod nad oedd yn cydymffurfio ag adran 53 Deddf Rheoli Tollau Tramor a Chartref 1979, bu i chi fethu darparu i'r swyddog priodol o fewn yr amser a ganiatawyd

(A)_[y manylion nad oeddynt wedi'u cynnwys yn, neu eu darparu gyda, y cofnod er bod angen gwneud hynny]_
(B)_[y dogfennau nad oeddynt wedi'u cynnwys yn, neu eu darparu gyda, y cofnod er bod angen gwneud hynny]_
(C)_[cofnod yn ei le wedi'i ganiatáu gan y swyddog priodol ac yn cydymffurfio â'r adran honno]_
